name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.

Data-attribute form

data-np-scroll-area, no class needed.

Added horizontal and vertical scrollbars.

Thumb colour follows the border token.

Keyboard focus shows the shared focus ring.

Works without JavaScript in plain HTML.

Respects light and dark themes.

Override the thumb with one variable.

Orientation

np-scroll-area-vertical and np-scroll-area-horizontal limit scrolling to one axis.

Only the y axis scrolls here, even though this line is wider than the box.

Second line.

Third line.

Fourth line.

Only the x axis scrolls here, so this line keeps going and going.

Scroll fade

np-scroll-fade or data-np-scroll-fade fades the edges that still have content. Needs scroll-driven animations.

Fade appears at the bottom first.

Scroll down and the top edge fades too.

At the end only the top edge fades.
